analysis: Prior-case-excluded sensitivity subset of the existing frozen common test
timing: Before the exposure registry is computed, before any v27/v29/v30 common-test predictions or scores. Development results are already observed. This does not resplit data, fit a model or choose a method.
population: Start with all890 test patients in the fixed v27 MIMIC-IV panel. Retain all visits of every patient absent from the union of known prior model/cohort membership records. Use exactly the same resulting patients in the full271 and molecular219 panels. Preserve original targets, including OOV and zero-target conventions.
registry: Reconstruct deterministic original membership for v2 6h/24h baselines and its support-task experiment; v3 method pilot; v4-v6 common samples; v7 new proposal/guard/test samples; read the actual local v9/v15 parameter-case membership and v21/v27 stored memberships. Include prepared review-manifest patients conservatively. v21 also covers v22/v23; v9/v15 cover v26/v31 parameter-case subsets; v27 training/development membership covers v29/v30. Current v27 test membership is reserved and excluded from the prior-exposure union. Keep source hashes, counts, reconstruction checks, alias provenance and all pairwise overlaps.
coverage_limits: The registry covers the named PRISMATIC MIMIC-IV experiment families. It cannot establish absence from foundation-model pretraining, undocumented external use or unrecorded experiments. Preparing population-level cohort audits is not treated as model-exposure evidence. Accordingly this is a prior-record-excluded sensitivity subset, not proof of globally untouched clinical confirmation.
selection: Membership uses patient identity and recorded prior roles only, never labels, predictions or error rates. Keep every remaining original-test patient; do not search an alternate subset or size threshold. If none remain, report zero feasible patients and no sensitivity scores. Freeze a local membership file and public digest before test inference.
evaluation: After the original common-test and program-test audits pass, subset their exact immutable predictions. Report all selected main-table methods with the same set scorer, source-DDI coverage, seed means/SD and descriptive paired patient intervals. Also report the excluded-patient panel separately to expose composition differences. Do not alter the primary all-patient table, select a winner, retune checkpoints or pool strata.
audit: Independently reconstruct the legacy deterministic samples and reserved test identities; verify the exact exclusion union, absence of retained/prior-patient intersection and complete visit retention. Validate source/membership hashes and confirm no existing common-test prediction files at freeze time. Restricted identities remain local; publish only aggregate counts and digests.
claim: This complements the exploratory main comparison and the separate eICU held-out-hospital study. It does not create external data or cure source timing/mapping limitations. No clinical review or new API calls are required.
